canonicalBcp47Mapping.note: Canonical BCP-47 tags are derived deterministically from each store caption using the retained caption map and explicit region/script cues. Google Play explicit tags in the excerpt (for example 'Afrikaans - af') are authoritative and used directly; Apple App Store captions are normalized to canonical BCP-47 using the caption map plus explicit region/script cues only where the cue maps to a standard subregion or script code; non-standard source region forms such as 'Slovenia' or 'U.K.' are preserved as quoted source evidence in sourceCaption/regionToken and are not silently promoted to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes without evidence.
